:::: {.g-col-12 .landing-about}
JuliaBayes is a community-driven endeavour to support the development, shared maintenance, and promotion of Bayesian methods and software in the Julia programming language.

We aim to provide a welcoming and inclusive environment for all who would like to collaborate and contribute to the ecosystem.
